_doc.audience: Reviewing astrologers. This file is the rule set. Editing it changes the horoscope. It is not a citation of a verse.
_doc.counting: Whole-sign houses. The reference sign is house 1. The same count the chart already uses.
_doc.kuja_review: review-site supplement kuja-review-2026-11-07, items K01-K05, are still open. No answer is stored. This file follows the questions: three references reported separately (K02), whole-sign counting (K01, proposed), exceptions listed and not applied while K03 is open, two-chart cancellations not used on one chart (K04), calm wording and no marriage-failure line (K05). The term Kuja dosha is not in Brihat Jataka or Prasna Marga 1-16 (decision S3).
_doc.sources: status 'to_verify' means the traditional idea is the usual one and the chapter or verse was not confirmed here. Do not treat 'to_verify' as a quotation.

aspects._note: Parashari special aspects. Rahu and Ketu are given only the 7th here. Chapter to verify.

vargottama.rule: same sign in rasi and navamsa (D9)

yogakaraka.rule: A planet that rules one of houses 4, 7, 10 and one of houses 5 or 9. House 1 is both a kendra and a trikona, and the lagna lord is not called yogakaraka for that alone.

source.note: Moon with no planet in the 2nd or 12th. Sun is not counted. Kerala cancellation when the Moon is in a kendra, or a planet is in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon.
Jupiter in a kendra from the Moon. Debilitation is noted and does not by itself cancel.
The five planets in own or exaltation sign and in a kendra from the lagna.
A kendra lord and a trikona lord in conjunction, exchange, or mutual aspect. One-way aspect is not counted.
Lord of 6, 8, or 12 placed in one of the other dusthanas. Own dusthana is not enough while require_other_dusthana is true.
Sun and Mercury in the same sign. Combustion is noted and does not cancel.
Moon and Mars in the same sign. Aspect is not counted.
A debilitated planet whose sign lord, or the lord of its exaltation sign, is in a kendra from the lagna or the Moon.

exceptions.en: Mars in its own sign (Aries or Scorpio).
Mars in the 2nd in Gemini or Virgo.
Mars in the 4th in Aries or Scorpio.
Mars in the 7th in Cancer or Capricorn.
Mars in the 8th in Sagittarius or Pisces.
Mars in the 12th in Taurus or Libra.

not_applied_on_one_chart.en: The same indication in both charts is sometimes treated as cancelling. That needs the other chart, so it is not used here.
not_applied_on_one_chart.ml: രണ്ട് ജാതകങ്ങളിലും ഒരേ സൂചനയുണ്ടെങ്കിൽ ചിലർ ഒഴിവാക്കും. അതിന് മറ്റേ ജാതകം വേണം. ഇവിടെ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നില്ല.

source.note: Not in Brihat Jataka or Prasna Marga chapters 1-16. Houses 2, 4, 7, 8, 12 from the lagna, the Moon, and Venus, shown separately. Exceptions are listed and not applied while review items K01-K05 are open.

kala_sarpa.rule: All seven are in one open semicircle from Rahu to Ketu, or from Ketu to Rahu. A planet on the node longitude is not inside either arc.

source.note: A later classification. Not claimed from Brihat Jataka.

A circulated matching count: one point when Sun, Mars, Saturn, or Rahu is in house 1, 2, 4, 7, 8, or 12 from the lagna, the Moon, or Venus. This is a summary of one chart, not a match and not a verdict. Ketu is not counted. Confirm the houses and the weights.
The 8th nakshatra from the birth star, counting the birth star as 1.
